nativeEvidence.finding: Bundle has three static Home Screen widget variants plus ActivityConfiguration. Calendar & Weather small/medium; Calendar Events medium; Calendar Events Large large. No accessoryCircular/Rectangular/Inline families declared.

Provider reads saved app-group event/weather/settings values; requests timeline after15min, not guaranteed scheduling. Large events view dynamically caps visible rows at11; event list is not a week grid.

Uses selected calendar identities; EventKit full-access gate; combines native/local events, removes cancelled/revoked entries, excludes all-day and started events, sorts and limits future feed. Snapshot written to shared defaults then reload requested.
Activity authorization gate and start/stop/update; current source creates pushType:nil; retains at most3future timed events, staleDate next start. Not continuous provider polling or unlimited queue.
Lock Screen ActivityConfiguration plus DynamicIsland; countdown uses periodic60second view, not proof of fresh provider data. Distinct from static accessory widget.
Background refresh earliest request5min and availability gate; no guarantee that iOS runs at that interval.
Live/Stop control invokes manager toggle when supported.
